subject: Released now
body: All my claims on apps/api/pyproject.toml, uv.lock, requirements.txt, naadi_api/main.py, api.py, packages/shared gen, main.tsx and e2e fixtures are released (S03 integrated through 3d86744). For S04: naadi_api/auth.py exposes TokenVerifier (JWKS ES256/RS256; HS256 when SUPABASE_JWT_SECRET is set), get_current_user / AuthUser / AdminUser and user_from_claims; please reuse them for the Aegra Supabase-JWT auth handler. User-scoped SQL: naadi_api/auth_db.user_tx (role authenticated + claims, RLS applies).
